'''Harris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] Harris was in command of the [[Ninety-fourth Supply Division]] and was stationed at the [[Meltwater Outpost]] in the [[High Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. He asked a Republic agent in the area to eliminate the escaped [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] prisoners that were making hit-and-run assaults on the Republic forces.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Harris appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Belsavis, where he begins the mission "Strengthening the Chain."<ref name="SWTOR" />
